protocol: post-evaluation qualitative gallery from the frozen 512-prompt confirmation split
selection_rule: Among records where DPRM improves both CLIP-L/14 and CLIP-B/32 over Omni default, rank by standardized DPRM scores plus 0.25 times the standardized paired improvements; retain recognizable non-abstract prompts for display only.
metric_use: The gallery does not select the controller and does not add observations to aggregate metrics.

uniform_action.rule: SHA256(prompt|seed|salt) interpreted as an integer modulo five
